title: Toby Turtle and the Tall Grass
description: A tiny turtle feels too small to explore the meadow until he finds a clever way to see over the grass.
character_reference: a very small emerald-green turtle with a shiny polished shell patterned in golden hexagons

scenes.narration: Toby loved the meadow, but the grass blades were taller than trees to a tiny turtle.
scenes.visual: ground-level shot surrounded by giant vertical green blades of grass, looking up with a slightly overwhelmed expression, bright daytime sunlight filtering down

scenes.narration: Whenever he tried to look ahead, all he could see was a wall of green. He felt so tiny and left behind.
scenes.visual: front view pressing nose against thick grassy stalk, drooping shoulders, long neck stretched upward trying to peer past the stems

scenes.narration: His friend Pip the bird landed nearby. Pip suggested they find a higher spot to get a better view.
scenes.visual: looking down at small friendly blue bird perched on a smooth stone, attentive listening pose, head tilted sideways in curiosity

scenes.narration: Toby spotted a smooth, fallen log resting on a gentle slope. That looked like the perfect climbing spot.
scenes.visual: pointing short green flipper toward a weathered brown log covered in soft moss, determined facial expression, sunny woodland clearing

scenes.narration: With slow and steady steps, Toby scrambled up the mossy bark. Up and up he climbed.
scenes.visual: mid-climb action shot scrambling over textured green moss, focused eyes looking upward, gritty detailed tree bark surface

scenes.narration: At the top, the whole world opened up. He could see sparkling streams and colorful wildflowers stretching for miles.
scenes.visual: standing proudly atop the log, front flippers resting on shell edge, wide-eyed look of wonder at a breathtaking colorful landscape panorama

scenes.narration: Toby smiled, learning that you do not need to be big to see amazing things.
scenes.visual: happy cheerful smile looking directly forward, relaxed posture on elevated wooden surface, warm golden hour sunbeams casting gentle highlights

scenes.narration: Sometimes all you need is a new perspective. Follow along for more bedtime stories.
scenes.visual: nodding head affirmatively while waving one flipper, soft blurred meadow background, welcoming evening twilight colors
